params.body:
- Vehicle types (<= 640px): one row of icon tiles that fits without a scroll row; only the chosen type shows its name.
- Toolbar (<= 900px): a two-column grid. Row one: Filters toggle | sort select (label hidden, the select says 'Nieuwste eerst'). Row two: customer mode | favourites. The filter toggle moved into the toolbar; its Alpine state now lives on the component root.
- Desktop unchanged.
params.title: Stocklist on phones: type tiles and a two-row toolbar
